method: Equivalent-wire analytic image-charge proxy for two strips between infinite solid grounded planes. Zdiff = 120/sqrt(er) * {ln[(2b/(pi*r))*sin(pi*h_up/b)] - 0.5*ln[(cosh(pi*d/b)-cos(2*pi*h_up/b))/(cosh(pi*d/b)-1)]}; b=h_up+h_down; d=w+gap. A homogeneous er sensitivity sweep brackets the declared Er values but does not model the actual dielectric interfaces. r=w/4 and (w+t)/4 are shape sensitivity choices, not guaranteed bounds.
outer_formula: TI-style microstrip approximation: Z0=87/sqrt(er+1.41)*ln(5.98h/(.8w+t)); Zdiff=2Z0*(1-.48exp(-.96gap/h)). h=.1164,t=.035,er=4.16. Only a parallel outer segment with actual adjacent GND, not the internal trunk or uncoupled terminals.
limits: These numbers are analytic sensitivity cases, not rigorous upper/lower bounds, tolerance ranges, field-solver output, eye-diagram results, or fabricator qualification.
Actual finite rectangular strips, two dielectric materials, plane edges, near signal/power copper, coplanar GND after refill, soldermask, etched width and frequency dispersion are omitted.
Covered and uncovered labels describe idealized cross sections; real saved-fill edges are gradual multiconductor transitions.
In2 non-GND copper cannot automatically be treated as an equipotential GND plane. Its impedance/termination and coupling may change both odd and common modes.
No numerical length or skew acceptance threshold is imposed.
Nominal total declared thickness1.6168mm vs1.6mm is a production stack confirmation item, not by itself a fabrication defect.
